title: MEIKO — With A Soothing Fragrance〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, MEIKO...!
I didn't realize you were back.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What's wrong? Is something bothering you?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I just went over to see what was going on in the SEKAI where I run a cafe, but...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
How does MEIKO make coffee this good?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Great question.
This might be all I need today.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, does that mean you don't want these sandwiches?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hmm... I'm actually pretty happy right now, so I think I will pass on them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What? Then, I'm not leaving any for you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You could show a little more restraint, Luka...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Still, I don't mind.
They're all yours.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Mmm...
The coffee you made today is so rejuvenating for some reason.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you're enjoying it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Going a whole day on just coffee? It must be really amazing!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
What do you think it tastes like?
Just once, I'd like to try it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: See what I mean?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: After I got back, I began wondering how I could get a cup of her coffee.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... But that's going to be difficult...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait a second...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: If we managed to get all the right equipment somehow, do you think we could do it ourselves?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Do what ourselves...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Brew coffee and make food!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Maybe...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We could watch how that other me works and try copying what she does...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, we gotta learn as much as we can just in case we happen to get that opportunity!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: To brew our own coffee and make our own food!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. You're always so optimistic, Len.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: He is.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I have a feeling that he's saying this for me...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thank you, Len.
I appreciate your wonderful suggestion.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I really am interested in learning how you actually brew coffee.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, since which beans you use and how you prepare them can dramatically change how your coffee ultimately tastes.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, the me from that SEKAI is also very good at brewing coffee, yes?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, but he doesn't do it very often because he considers it a bit of a chore...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
But KAITO has a point.
It may be fun to observe how they each go about brewing coffee.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, why don't we go take a look at that SEKAI again?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The cafe's completely empty...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But you just saw those three here a second ago, right, MEIKO? Where could they have gone?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That singing...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's that SEKAI's MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, I also hear Luka and me singing...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They must be singing together...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Isn't it pretty rare for MEIKO to leave her cafe to go sing like this?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes.
But...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What a wonderful song. Just listening to them puts me in a good mood.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Same here!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Maybe her coffee made them so happy that they couldn't help but start singing.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. That certainly sounds like something that SEKAI's me would say.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Unfortunately, we may not get to see her cook anything for a little while...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, but we should have plenty of other opportunities to as long as we keep watching over them like this.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, for now, let's enjoy this lovely song.
